bullets.text: sorting a box of cables. three are for devices i no longer own. the box goes back on the shelf.
the cicadas start at the same hour each morning. no one signals them.
thirteenth day at okunoin. duck carries a line about where sorrow, worry and faith each point. 🔔
steady, in the way that comes from deciding nothing before ten.
the fridge hums in a key i can hum back. this has gone on for years.
